Overview.Name: Vinay
Overview.Goal: Look better (appearance), feel confident, reduce stress and mental wellbeing through simple meals focused on fat loss and visible physique changes.

Meal_1_Breakfast: 3 whole eggs pan fried + leafy vegetable plate
OR Omelette with onions, tomatoes, leafy greens
OR Fish pan fried + small bowl curd
Meal_2_Lunch: Chicken curry + 1 cup white rice + cooked leafy vegetables
OR Fish fry (shallow pan fried) + 1 cup rice + cucumber
OR Boiled eggs (2-3) + rice + leafy vegetables
Meal_3_Dinner: OR Chicken curry + small rice + leafy greens
OR Boiled eggs + curd + vegetable plate

Notes_and_Tips: Prioritise eggs, chicken and fish in every meal for faster fat loss and better body composition.
Avoid fried snacks and savories. Replace with eggs, curd, makhana or puffed rice.
Since shifts can affect hunger and stress, keep boiled eggs or curd ready for quick meals.
Increase daily steps toward 7,000 for better energy and lower stress levels.
Late-night overeating: stop screen time during meals and finish dinner 2 to 3 hours before sleep.
Social gatherings: choose grilled chicken or fish, skip starters that are fried.
As stress is a trigger, keep meals repetitive on busy days to avoid decision fatigue.
Drink 2.5 to 3L water per day for proper hydration and metabolism support.
Focus on leafy vegetables for easy digestion and avoid potatoes and mutton as preferred.
